title: Open Seminar; Reading the Listening: Literature, Criticism, and Music in the Hispanic Caribbean Literature
description: This course would like to rethink listening as an experience that work through some literary texts, materials, and performances in the Hispano-Caribbean archipelago. This course aspires to flesh out the category oflistening as an ethical and political disposition that works within various literary Caribbean texts and performances. Representations or uses of "musicality" will be worked on as recurring motifs in the selected bibliography, as well as other topics.
